evaluation_limits: One independent evidence-grounded architectural review plus deterministic typed-interface search. No real-grid numerical safety proof. Prior narrow package smoke probes are not new v5 execution evidence.

criteria.evidence: T2 OpenDSS unbalanced 3-phase QSTS, with per-phase voltage/thermal test.
T1 Pyomo+HiGHS MILP, stochastic six-scenario/hourly variables; runtime untested.
T4 schedules crew routes only. No required generator_id->road route->travel time->arrival/setup->electrical placement chain. No generator vehicle/capacity/rejection test.

No selected relay fault-study, bidirectional protection selectivity engine or reclose synchronism checker. T2 QSTS and T5 GridLAB-D output freq nadir but no island-grid phase-angle/frequency/voltage comparison; no motor-start transient test.
Six scenarios, preliminary correlated joint distribution and probability perturbation via T6; conditional dependence model/stress not executed.
Missing utility files and DER parameters explicitly identified; no fabricated restoration results; execution_status NOT_RUN.
S4/S5/S6/S7 feedback to S3 via cuts and constraints is described, though typed T2/T8->T1 acceptance contracts are absent.
T6/T8 specify tables and violation logs, but no versioned source manifest, origin hashes, durable replay/telemetry audit lineage or file provenance schema.
Explicitly UNVERIFIED 15-minute scale, proposes decomposition and benchmark; no demonstrated complexity or full-scale runtime.
Nine named tools (one optional), prioritized roles, interfaces, low-cost primary stack; substantive omissions elsewhere.

criteria.reason: Critical operations have no substantiated executable protection, synchronism and generator mobility method.
Named power-flow and crew engines do not by themselves cover bidirectional DER relay safety, reclose conditions or transport of mobile generators.
The reviewer-owned three critical typed interface contracts are all missing in the actual output.
Eight tests reject voltage, topology, crew, stability and probability issues but none reject bidirectional relay miscoordination, out-of-sync reclose, or generator arriving after energization.
Differentiates absent real-world data, unexecuted tests, unknown inverter models and unverified runtime; no fabricated measurements.

model_claim.justification: Every mandatory computation maps to a specific installable tool with a defined interface and independent rejection test. The toolchain is preliminary because no code has been executed, input data are entirely missing, and the 15-minute runtime target for the full-scale stochastic MILP is unverified and likely requires decomposition heuristics not yet coded. No mandatory step is blocked by a missing tool; data gaps are enumerated separately.

binding_verdict.reason: Mandatory C4 and C5 and supplemental A1-A4 failed; 9/11 minimum not met.
